audit.whatIsWrong: Yorick's E is called a cage and a root throughout: "E mist-cage marks you", "a mist-marked cage that slows", "reposition out of the E cage", "Land E mist-cage to root you in place", "his ghoul-and-Maiden autos through the E cage".
audit.why: Mourning Mist is a thrown globule at 700 range that damages, slows, marks, and REDUCES ARMOUR. It does not root and it is not a cage — the cage is Dark Procession, a separate ability on W that summons a destructible wall. Telling a Malphite he is rooted when he is only slowed changes his decision from "walk out through the slow" to "give up and eat the trade", and it sends him looking for the wrong ability to dodge. Two distinct abilities are currently merged into one invented one.
audit.corrected: Mourning Mist named as the armour-shredding slow-and-mark, Dark Procession as the wall. Applied to spikes[0], spikes[1], wants.you[0], wants.you[2], wants.foe[0], early, mid, whys[0], whys[1] and whys[4].
sources: champ-data/_kits/yorick.json (E "throws a globule of Black Mist that reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies", 700 range; W "summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement")

audit.whatIsWrong: Mourning Mist's armour reduction is never mentioned once, in any field.
audit.why: It is the single most important line in Yorick's kit for this specific matchup, twice over. Ground Slam deals magic damage BASED ON MALPHITE'S ARMOUR, so every Mourning Mist directly cuts the damage of your only trade button — and it does it at range, on an 8-to-12 second cooldown, with no commitment from him. Second, the mark it applies speeds his Mist Walkers toward you, so the shred and the swarm are the same cast. The entry's plan of "stack armour and tank the ghouls" is being quietly undone by an ability the page does not know exists.
audit.corrected: Stated in early, mid, spikes[2], whys[0] and whys[5], with the sequencing rule that Ground Slam should be out before his E lands, not after.
sources: champ-data/_kits/yorick.json (E "reduces armor... Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets", cd 12/11/10/9/8)
champ-data/_kits/malphite.json (E "deals magic damage based on his Armor")

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and Last Rites is never named or described despite being his every-trade button.
audit.why: Three numbers change how the lane is played. Last Rites is 6 seconds down to 4 — an auto-attack reset that heals him, so his wind-up is the tell to step back, and his sustain is why chip damage never sticks (Grievous Wounds matters and is not mentioned). Dark Procession is 20 down to 12 seconds, which is the actual window in which your R path cannot be walled off. And Eulogy of the Isles is 160/130/100 against Unstoppable Force's 130/115/100: your ultimate is back a full 30 seconds sooner at rank 1, which is precisely why level 6 and the first item are your window rather than a vague "spike".
audit.corrected: Last Rites named with its cooldown, heal and auto-reset tell in early and wants.foe; the R comparison in spikes[1] and whys[4]; Dark Procession's cooldown in mid.
sources: champ-data/_kits/yorick.json (Q 6/5.5/5/4.5/4 "bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself", W 20/18/16/14/12, R 160/130/100)

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart labels Level 6 "Skill" and First item "Yorick", while spikes[1] calls level 6 "your single biggest window" and spikes[2] plus whys[5] both say the first armour item lets you out-trade him on the wave.
audit.why: Two stages contradict their own descriptions. The rest of the chart is right: Yorick genuinely owns levels 2-3 with Mourning Mist and the swarm before Thunderclap exists, and he genuinely reclaims the late game with Maiden and the side lane, which is what a 51.52% win rate over 1023 games looks like — a lane you win and a game he can take back.

edits.before: Yorick owns the opening. His E throws a mist-marked cage that slows and lets his ghouls swarm you — that ghoul DPS chews through your Granite Shield before it can refresh, and you have no trade pattern at Levels 1-3 to answer it. Don't try to fight the ghouls; last-hit at max range, use Q's slow and movement-steal to reposition out of the E cage, and never get walked into his W-wall against your tower. Accept the chip and farm — you cannot win a Level-2 brawl into a marked Maiden swing.
edits.after: Yorick owns the opening, and Mourning Mist is why. It is a 700-range globule that slows, marks, and REDUCES YOUR ARMOUR — which is the stat Ground Slam's damage is calculated from, so every cast makes your one trade button weaker while speeding his Mist Walkers onto the mark. It slows you; it does not root you, so walk out through it using Seismic Shard's speed steal. His Last Rites is a 6-second auto reset that heals him, so his wind-up is your cue to step back, not his cast.

edits.before: This is where you stabilize and then spike. At Levels 4-5 Thunderclap's bonus armor and empowered AoE autos plus Ground Slam's attack-speed slow let you eat ghoul swarms and shove the wave back, so farm settles to even. Then Level 6 is your single biggest window: Unstoppable Force gives you the all-in and roam threat you simply lacked. Bait or wait out his E mist-cage — if you R into him while it's on cooldown and his Maiden is shoved across the lane, you have a real kill, especially flash-R or a wall-R he can't body-block.
edits.after: This is where you stabilize and then spike. At Levels 4-5 Thunderclap's bonus armour finally outpaces Mourning Mist's shred, so Ground Slam keeps its damage and its attack-speed slow caps the swarm — get E out before his mist lands, not after. Level 6 is your biggest window, and the number is the reason: Eulogy of the Isles is 160 seconds at rank 1 against your 130. The ability to actually watch is Dark Procession, 20 seconds at rank 1 — inside that gap nothing can wall off your R path.

edits.before: Be honest: Yorick takes the late game back. Once he has Maiden up and items, his E-cage plus the ghoul-and-Maiden swarm zones you completely off the wave, and he wins the straight 1v1 in a side lane — you cannot duel him there as a low-economy tank. Your job flips entirely to teamfighting: stack armor, soak with Granite Shield and Ground Slam, and save your R for a flank onto their carry. Don't try to match his splitpush — make the game happen 5v5 where your knock-up matters more than his side-lane.
edits.after: Be honest: Yorick takes the late game back. With Maiden up, Mourning Mist shredding on an 8-second cooldown and the swarm behind it, he zones you off the wave and wins the side-lane 1v1 a low-economy tank cannot contest. Note also that Last Rites heals him every 4 seconds, so chip alone never sticks — bring Grievous Wounds if you must fight him. Your job flips to teamfighting: soak, and save R for a flank onto their carry. Make the game happen 5v5, not in his side lane.

notes: The packet flags "Ground Slam's" in wants.you[1] as a probable wrong ability name at edit distance 2 from "ground slam". That is a false positive — Ground Slam is Malphite's real E and the possessive apostrophe is what tripped the check. I rewrote that field for a different reason (the armour-shred interaction) and kept the name. Separately, the entry's claim that Dark Procession can "block your R path entirely" is plausible from the kit — it is a destructible wall that blocks enemy movement — but nothing states whether it stops a dash mid-flight, so I kept the existing phrasing rather than strengthening it into a rule. Also inherited from the Zac mirror: Malphite's Q and E "grounding" flags are tooltip artefacts of "through the ground" and "slams the ground", and nothing here is written on them.
